content.short: Tonik is a pioneering Philippine digital bank with high-yield savings, deposits, cards and loans.
content.description: Tonik is a digital bank in the Philippines, widely recognized as one of the country's first neobanks to hold a digital banking licence from the central bank. Operating entirely through its app, it offers high-yield savings accounts and Stashes, deposit accounts, debit cards and consumer loans, targeting Filipinos who are underbanked or seeking better returns than traditional banks provide. Tonik focuses on attractive interest rates, fast digital onboarding and secure deposits to win trust in a market where many people are new to formal banking. By combining savings, deposits, cards and credit in a mobile-first experience, it competes with other Philippine digital banks for the country's fast-growing base of smartphone users.
